additional_info.subject: ID0437798-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000340]Fault on the CHAdeMO handle CRM:00798002342
additional_info.body:
Hi Ferdinand,
We have analysed the logs. And our observations are as follows:
We could see there is delay in the Converter group allocation.
From Software POV, We need to ensure the Charger at latest FW as we have update of CG in further FW.
From HW POV,
We need to check TF5, if it is malfunctioning, recommend having spares while site intervention.
We also recommend to check PowerConverter[1] & [4] for malfunctioning. Serial number of Converter enclosed in snippet. We can also check if there are any welding in the DC bus bar.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0437798 ﻿from the
Technical Support

additional_info.body:
Hello Antonio,
Hope you are doing well.
The global team have performed an analysis on the system and identified there was some issues around power converter grouping.
To evaluate a more recent charging session, would you be able to advise us, if this has been experienced again recently?
We reviewed some recent logs and saw a good charging session on connector 1.
A date and time when it wasnt behaving would be helpful to understand if the issue is still present.
Thanks.
With Kind Regards,
